chars.MOM: MOM: a kind Moroccan woman in her late 50s, round face, wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba and a cream headscarf
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman, late 20s, sharp eyebrows, long straight black hair loose, wearing a fitted burgundy satin blouse and black wide trousers, gold hoop earrings
chars.HAMZA: HAMZA: a Moroccan man around 30, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a light-blue office shirt with rolled sleeves and grey chinos
chars.LEILA: LEILA: a Moroccan young woman, mid 20s, wearing a navy hoodie and a soft pink headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the open doorway of a modern Moroccan apartment living room: WIFE stands mid-scold, leaning over and pointing her finger down at MOM who sits small and hurt on a sofa, hands in her lap. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, subjects centered.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: MOM stands at the door of an apartment in a Casablanca building stairwell, holding a plastic bag of homemade msemen, knocking with a hopeful small smile. Seen from the stairs below, subject centered.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: WIFE opens the apartment door halfway with a cold forced smile and arms crossed, MOM in the doorway smiling politely. Seen from the hallway behind MOM's shoulder, faces visible, subjects centered.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a modern living room, WIFE sits across from MOM with a smug look, talking sharply with a raised hand, while MOM sits stiffly and lowers her eyes, an untouched glass of mint tea on the table between them. Subjects centered.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: HAMZA walks in through the front door with a work bag, surprised; WIFE turns to him and gestures at MOM accusingly; MOM sits on the sofa in the background, upset. Subjects centered.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a simple Moroccan family home with traditional sedari cushions, MOM sits crying, wiping tears with her headscarf, while LEILA kneels beside her holding her hand, worried. Subjects centered.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: WIFE stands tall in front of HAMZA and points at MOM, mocking her, while HAMZA stands silent with his head down and does nothing; MOM, small in the foreground from behind, faces them. Subjects centered, faces of WIFE and HAMZA visible.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A happy Moroccan family living room: MOM laughing and holding a newborn baby wrapped in a white blanket, LEILA smiling beside her, warm light, colourful cushions. Subjects centered.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: At a notary office desk in Morocco, WIFE smiles slyly as she watches HAMZA sign papers for a house, a small model of a house and keys on the desk; HAMZA looks tired and unsure. Subjects centered.
